items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc5NDQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--077ba870fd7bd2d112099785fe48363d3fa3efe5/Turn%20It%20Caracas%202026.png) ## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español ## Bienvenido a Turn It! Caracas 2026 **Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.** * Límite de **50** competidores para el registro. * Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia. * **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TurnItCaracas2026#74841-nuevos-competidores-newcomers) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla. * Si tiene dudas, contactar al equipo organizador. #### 📸 Aviso de Filmación Al asistir a **Turn It! Caracas 2026**, autorizas a la organización a tomar fotografías y grabar videos durante el evento. Estas imágenes podrán ser utilizadas para la promoción futura de competencias, redes sociales y sitio web oficial, transmisiones en vivo, así como para material documental y archivo histórico. Si no deseas aparecer en ninguna grabación, por favor notifícalo al equipo organizador al momento de tu registro o durante el evento. Tu participación implica la aceptación de este aviso. ## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English ## Welcome to Turn It! Caracas 2026 **Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.** * Competitor registration limit: **50**. * It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience. * **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TurnItCaracas2026#74842-) for you. It is very important to read it. * If you have any questions, contact the organizing team. #### 📸 Filming Notice By attending **Turn It! Caracas 2026**, you authorize the organization to take photographs and record videos during the event. These images may be used for future competition promotion, social media and official website, live streaming, as well as for documentary and historical archive material. If you do not wish to appear in any recording, please notify the organizing team at the time of registration or during the event. Your participation implies acceptance of this notice. ## **Información de Contacto / Contact Info:** • Enrymar Cisneros Teléfono: 0426-5335576 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584265335576&text=%C2%A1Hola,%20Enrymar!%20Quiero%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Turn It!%20Caracas%202026*) speedcubingvenezuela@gmail.com • Patricia Barrios Teléfono: 0412-5975095 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584125975095&text=%C2%A1Hola,%20Patricia!%20Quiero%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Turn%20It!%20Caracas%202026*) speedcubingcaracas@gmail.com

You are also welcome to join the Facebook group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). Please **review all of the tabs on this website**. You **only need to show up for events that you're competing in**, but we encourage you to stay longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly in the afternoon — **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. An email with information and reminders will be sent a few days before the competition. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media, and other digital platforms.
